dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll tell you what needs balancing. It's...

dialogues.speaker: Toyanna
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, sorry. That was a corny line, I know!

dialogues.speaker: Toyanna
dialogues.text: I just... When I see a huge gap in the number of Saurians landing on one side of the high ground compared to the other, I start feeling a little... upset.

dialogues.speaker: Toyanna
dialogues.text: But if I go and disturb the resting Qucusaurus, asking them to relocate, it'd be making a mountain out of a molehill...

dialogues.speaker: Toyanna
dialogues.text: *sigh* And if that keeps happening, the Saurians will hate me...

dialogues.speaker: Toyanna
dialogues.text: So, jokes aside, I'm afraid I really will have to find balance within myself.
